name: nopekit
description: Turn a sketch or a discussion into a validated physical thing — hardware, CAD, PCBs, simulation, fabrication

plugins.name: nopekit
plugins.description: Design real physical things with an agent: extract the claims that must be true, generate everything from one parametric model, gate every claim with a validator that can actually fail, and produce a readiness report that separates what is proven from what is assumed. Grows new validation capabilities (CFD, FEA, thermal, chemical) on demand instead of prebaking them.
